result.rationale: The diff in create.handler.ts changes `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which literally inverts the condition: previously slug was only set when team billing was DISABLED; now it is only set when billing is ENABLED. This is a real behavioral inversion on a flag-unrelated file for this PR, and the finding correctly identifies the flipped logic. Whether the new direction is intentional (possibly a fix of a prior bug) cannot be fully verified from the diff, so moderate confidence.

judged_text: The slug spread was rewritten from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, inverting the flag condition on an unrelated file in this PR. Deployments with IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED=false now create organizations with no slug at all (org routing/lookup by slug breaks, or Prisma rejects the write), while billing-enabled orgs get slug set immediately, bypassing the requestedSlug moderation flow the old code implemented.
